name: std::basic_spanstream<CharT,Traits>::swap
intro:
Exchanges the state of the stream with those of other.

This is done by calling std::basic_iostream<CharT, Traits>::swap(other) and swapping the wrapped std::basic_spanbuf objects (accessible through *rdbuf()).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
other

 -

  stream to exchange the state with

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Read or write a number using a fixed 16-character buffer that outlives the stream.

summary: Exchanges the state of the stream with those of other.
